notes: Press release dated August 6, 2026: heat wave warning in effect since July 23 for two weeks; first highest-level heat wave emergency warning of summer 2026 issued August 4 at 11 AM for the entire city. SMG suspended outdoor construction at city-commissioned sites, expanded road washing and 'cooling roads', provided 440 million won in emergency grants to district governments, allocated ~20.5 billion won from the disaster relief fund to give 50,000 won cooling support to ~410,000 low-income households, and is inspecting ~4,000 heat shelters and monitoring ~63,000 health-vulnerable residents.
recommended_action: Pitch Talaix real-time heat monitoring, district-level exposure analytics and SMS alerting for vulnerable-population protection (jjokbang residents, elderly living alone, mobility workers) to SMG and the 25 district governments; offer a professional report on urban heat island response.
